name: Toriel's Embrace
source:
After a devastating breakup, you seek a moment of peace, only to fall deep into the Underground. Battered and broken, you are rescued by Toriel, who nurses you back to health in the Ruins. As you recover in her care, you begin to explore the Underground. The choices you make from then on are up to you.

[From [url=https://ohdeerpatreon.itch.io/toriels-embrace]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经历了一场痛彻心扉的分手后，只想寻得片刻宁静的你却意外坠入了深邃的地底世界。遍体鳞伤的你被托丽尔救起，在她的悉心照料下于“遗迹”中慢慢养好了伤势。在她的关怀下日渐康复后，你开始动身探索这片地底世界。自此往后的一切抉择，全由你来决定。

[摘自[url=https://ohdeerpatreon.itch.io/toriels-embrace]itch.io[/url]]
